data.name: Acavallo AC055 Active Pony Gel Pad Cut Out Sheepskin
data.short_description:
Acavallo® pony non-slip flat gel with Classic design and cut-out sheepskin. Shockproof, non-slip and breathable.


The pony non-slip gel flat with Classic design and cut-out sheepskin offers excellent contact with the saddle, allowing the skin to breathe while riding. Thanks to the shaped gel, the item is thicker than a traditional pad, providing an effective combination of non-slip and cushioning. The Acavallo® Classic gel is hypoallergenic, non-toxic and does not cause unwanted reactions in contact with the skin, allowing the direct use. Furthermore, the gel can be easily cut and adapted to any type of saddle. A significant advantage of this gel is its ability to prevent unwanted movement of the saddle in all directions: forward, backward and sideways. The gel is able to compensate for small imperfections in the horse's back, making it also suitable for backs with more rounded conformations. The central part has a reduced thickness to better adapt to the horse's withers and back, allowing a large space between the saddle and the gel for constant air circulation. The Acavallo® sheepskin used in the gel edge is a hypoallergenic, soft and delicate natural material, designed to prevent chafing, abrasions and blisters. Acavallo® sheepskin has a very high density of fibers per square centimeter, making it the best natural emollient padding. Furthermore, the sheepskin acts as a 100% insulator, avoiding the emission of electrostatic charges in contact with the horse's skin. Another essential characteristic of this material is its ability to absorb sweat and release it to the outside air seven times faster than synthetic materials.

The real Acavallo® sheepskin edge not only gives a touch of elegance to the compensator, but the properties of the material: natural, hypoallergenic, soft and delicate, are able to prevent chafing, abrasions and blisters. The wool is selected by Acavallo® for the high density of fibers per square centimeter, in order to create the best possible natural emollient padding. Furthermore, sheepskin does not emit electrostatic charges if the pad rubs with the horse's skin, thus acting as a 100% insulator. Sheepskin immediately absorbs sweat and releases it to the outside air seven times faster than synthetic materials.


Care Instructions

  • Machine washable at 30°C or by hand with mild soap and water
  • Do not use aggressive cleaning agents
  • Do not tumble dry
  • Do not expose to direct heat or strong sunlight
  • Let it dry naturally
